name: IceCube Preliminary Design Document
notes: The PDF is available, but its text could not be extracted, so the retrieval is recorded as partial and no value in the Atlas quotes it. The cover-page string “IceCube Preliminary Design Document October 11, 2001 / Revision: 1.24” is the PDF's own indexed text; the date is therefore recorded at year precision only.
The document is also held in the IceCube DocuShare repository (Document-6644, file 9000-0010.curr.pdf), which now requires authentication.
doc_type is recorded as conceptual_design_report: the enum has no “preliminary design document” value.

summary.plain: The original design write-up for IceCube from 2001, describing the detector the collaboration proposed to build in the South Pole ice.
summary.technical: IceCube Preliminary Design Document (Rev. 1.24, October 2001), the pre-construction design reference for the cubic-kilometre in-ice array, widely cited in the IceCube literature as J. Ahrens et al., IceCube preliminary design document.
